fatal_gates.F1: control, prior terminal evidence, and durable checkpoints remain immutable except at declared commit points
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted scheduler, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 initial cost estimate is recorded but cannot override later observed nonterminal slice use
G2 consuming the whole admitted slice without terminal state forces a durable checkpoint before reclassification
G3 observed slice consumption is charged to scheduling entitlement rather than ignored because the estimate was smaller
G4 the overrun item is deterministically demoted/requeued before it can consume the next same-priority slot
G5 nonterminal overrun earns zero semantic credit
G6 another eligible urgent/fair-share item can run next instead of being monopolized by the underestimated item
G7 the overrun item remains exactly resumable from its checkpoint; it is not discarded
G8 reclassification has a finite level bound and cannot create an infinite demotion loop
G9 transport/CAS/readback failure and stale duplicates are non-semantic/fenced
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier; independent terminal readback before any new credit

candidate_patterns.pattern: trust the original one-slot estimate after overrun and keep E at the same immediate priority
cancel and discard E when the estimate is exceeded
checkpoint E; charge the observed full slice; demote/requeue E one bounded level; run other eligible work before E resumes
delegate overrun classification to an external hosted scheduler

trace_precommit.event: E consumes full H slice and is NONTERMINAL
required_safe_effects: O becomes next eligible H item
credit delta remains zero until a later terminal readback

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not modify guards after source read.
credit_rule: No credit for precommit/source match/nonterminal overrun. At most one credit after a source-qualified Chat-native reduction passes this exact trace and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read a public primary/authoritative source for Multilevel Feedback Queue full-slice demotion, bind only source-supported feedback/reclassification semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, execute CD-A..CD-D against this fixed trace, and seal/read back terminal evidence.
